PAYROLL.TITLE: Payroll Management
PAYROLL.SUBTITLE: Dual-basis wage calculation (Hours vs Trips), minimum wage protection, and compliance auditing
PAYROLL.DIALOG_CREATE_DESC: Creates a standard fortnightly pay period starting on a Monday (F7.7).

PAYROLL.VOID_DESC: Voiding will revert the period to draft state. A formal reason is required for compliance audit.
PAYROLL.SETTLED_BASIS_BANNER: Settled via {basis}: Higher of Hours-Based ({hoursGross}) vs Trip-Based ({tripGross})
PAYROLL.MIN_WAGE_NOTICE: Statutory Minimum Wage Protection Notice: Gross earnings for this period have been topped up to comply with the NZ Minimum Wage Act 1983 based on total payable hours recorded.
PAYROLL.FINES_PARTITION_TITLE: Traffic Fines Partition (NZ Wages Protection Act 1983)
PAYROLL.FINES_LEGAL_BANNER: Under the Wages Protection Act 1983, employer deductions from wages are unlawful without prior written consent. Fines are strictly tracked for informational purposes and ARE NOT deducted from payroll ($0.00 deduction).
PAYROLL.NO_FINES_IN_PERIOD: No traffic fines recorded for this driver during the pay period.
